title: Dubai World Cup
metaDescription: The Dubai World Cup is the season-ending international horse-racing meeting at Meydan Racecourse

overview.about: The Dubai World Cup is one of the richest days in horse racing, staged each March under the lights at the Meydan Racecourse in Dubai. The feature race carries a multi-million-dollar purse and draws top thoroughbreds and trainers from around the world to a glamorous, floodlit meeting. The 2027 running is on 27 March.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Dubai World Cup is held on 27 March at Meydan Racecourse. The card features several rich international races across dirt and turf, with the main event run over 2,000 metres on the dirt track under floodlights.
